rationale: Wing Chuen Lam's hands-on robotics and humanoid-robotics expertise could complement Ming Guo's work on verifiable compute systems — particularly as ZKM explores decentralized AI applications where physical systems need cryptographic proofs of computation. Ming's deep experience architecting zkVMs and DAC Economy philosophy could inform how robotics automation integrates with trustless, verifiable systems at scale.
intro_message: Wing Chuen Lam, meet Ming Guo — Ming is building zkVM infrastructure for verifiable compute in AI and blockchain, and your robotics systems background could be valuable as that world intersects with decentralized applications.
